title: Conversion Layer — Easy to Understand, Sell and Share
summary: YTIntel now explains its paid value in seconds: the public experience leads with the expensive creator problem it solves, demonstrates the full Research → Validate → Package → Learn workflow, differentiates YTIntel from generic AI, handles buyer objections and gives the owner a one-click marketing kit for outreach, posts and demos.
discord_changes: Rebuilt the public value story around one sellable promise: decide what deserves production time before spending hours making the wrong video.
Added a 60-second illustrative product example, clear paid-value outcomes, use cases for solo creators / faceless channels / agencies, and a YTIntel-vs-generic-AI comparison.
Added a one-click Marketing Kit with the product one-liner, short sales pitch, outreach DM, short-form video hook and shareable demo link.
changes: Rewrote the public hero around the core buyer pain: reducing uncertainty before committing writing, filming, editing and thumbnail time.
Added a conversion-focused value section that explains what a paying creator is buying: better idea selection, evidence-backed packaging and a research advantage that compounds.
Added a 60-second illustrative walkthrough showing how one topic becomes discovery, validation, packaging and Creator Loop learning.
Added a direct comparison between generic AI brainstorming and YTIntel's evidence-first creator intelligence workflow.
Added dedicated buyer use cases for solo creators, faceless/high-volume channels and agencies/teams so visitors can self-identify quickly.
Added a recurring-value stack for Competitor Watchtower, Opportunity Radar, Deep Analyse, Packaging Lab, Idea Vault and Creator Loop.
Added an objection-handling FAQ covering guarantees, YouTube account connection, user credits, generic AI and why the product has repeat-use value.
Added top-level Why YTIntel and Share YTIntel actions so returning users can reopen the sales story or share the product without hunting through the app.
Added a Marketing Kit modal with copy-ready one-line pitch, short sales pitch, outreach DM, short-form video script and demo link.
Added ?demo=1 and ?pitch=1 / ?marketing=1 deep links so marketing campaigns can open directly into the product walkthrough or marketing kit.
Updated the browser title and social-description copy dynamically around the clearer creator outcome.
Returning users with existing workspace history keep the command-center-first experience while new visitors see the full conversion story by default.
Preserved v0.22 Creator Command Center, Watchtower, Idea Vault, Always-On analysis, winner-vs-control checks, originality guardrails and no-guarantee positioning.
why_it_matters: A product is hard to sell when the prospect has to understand the feature list before understanding the outcome. v0.23 makes YTIntel easy to pitch in one sentence, easy to demonstrate in one minute, easy for a visitor to map to their own use case, and easy for the owner to share repeatedly without rebuilding the sales message each time.
